violations.text: Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils ( slicer) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Slicer to be broken down before use and after every use and to be fully washed, rinsed, and sanitized. All staff to be instructed on how to properly sanitize all parts of slicer. New Violation. Correct By: 11/16/2026

Pasta/cheese was observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. New Violation. Correct By: 11/16/2026

The floors in the stairs/basement area has an accumulation of old rodent droppings. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 11/16/2026

The floors in the basement area and walls in the stairs is in poor repair(gaps/holes.) The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. Gaps/holes to be repaired. New Violation. Correct By: 11/30/2026
No person certified in food safety was present as needed at the time of inspection. Another person to get certified. New Violation. Correct By: 01/16/2025

An employee was observed touching ready to eat bread with bare hands. Food employees must not touch exposed, ready-to-eat food with their bare hands and shall use suitable utensils such as deli tissue, spatulas, single use gloves, or dispensing equipment. Bread was disposed of. Proper glove use reviewed with PIC. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 01/02/2025
The hot water handle of the hand sink was observed in poor repair. Per PIC, handle is in the process of being repaired. New Violation. Correct By: 01/02/2025
